name: @shuhaowu/pi-tps-report
description: A [pi](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi-coding-agent) extension that shows a status widget above the editor with token throughput metrics: **PP** (prefill), **TG** (token generation), and **Last TTFT** (time to first token).
